How people are doing the one prompt edit with Claude. No DM for resources, everything you need is right here.

1. Install Claude Code (Codex works too). Download the desktop app.
2. Open Claude Code. It opens in Chat, so switch it over to Code.
3. Make a folder on your computer. Mine is called My Bo
